item.title: 06: Every Man His Own Balloon - DesignObserver
item.description: I’ve been thinking about halos. And the halo effect (which is its own kind of myth). The simplicity of that geometric form, a simple curvature above the head. The perfection of it. The divinity of it.

item.title: Your Black History Month reading list - DesignObserver
item.description: In honor of Black History Month, here are some Black authors who are addressing the persistent issues of inclusion in the modern design era.

item.title: Every problem is a design problem. This one is public safety. - DesignObserver
item.description: When it comes to regulating the government's use of AI, we need civic engagement to guide the future of public safety

item.title: 07: Meltdown - DesignObserver
item.description: I have been thinking about wax as a medium for simulation, about how I might use it to morph or maneuver the skin into some kind of altered state. Tissue stripped away, facial integrity diluted. A face that dissolves.

item.title: 08: Featherweight - DesignObserver
item.description: Recently I have been thinking of Icarus as a kind of footsoldier, out scavenging in an open field. Acquiring his arsenal. Gathering materials, and weighing his options. (Weighing his fate.)

item.title: If you have good taste and excellent discernment, this is your time to shine. - DesignObserver
item.description: We need good humans with good judgment to decide which problems to solve and which solutions are most promising.

item.title: 09: Hullabaloo - DesignObserver
item.description: Polyommatus Icarus is known colloquially as the common blue butterfly. Its adult lifespan lasts, on average, two to three weeks.

item.title: Power is designed - DesignObserver
item.description: The Epstein files expose how systems are built to protect power. Accountability requires making power visible and open to scrutiny.

item.title: 10: Precipice - DesignObserver
item.description: I have been thinking about Icarus’s father, Daedalus, and about the often persistent impasse between adults and adolescents that is hardly unique to Greek myth. Unspoken rivalries. Complex legacies. A parable of a different sort.

item.title: Systems are failing. Just ask airport staff. - DesignObserver
item.description: Airport systems operators (currently unpaid, overworked, and quitting) are the key to systems resillience.
